summary: The proof is complete and exact. The three integer sections and midpoint compatibility are correct; the affine area scaling is consistent; the reduction to through-point halfspaces covers the whole-space, slice-parallel, closed-boundary, and vertex-incidence cases; the one-vertex cap parametrization and lambda range are exhaustive; all endpoint corner-cone inequalities and residual Y-cone Cauchy bounds have the stated rational margins; undoing the scale gives the claimed 1/1600 improvement; and the strict-low endpoint interior covers and middle-slice non-cover corollary handle open, closed, empty, and full sections correctly.
